step-1.text: Flip the top onto something soft, underside up.

step-2.text: Slide the clamp of a leg over one corner until it sits square against both edges, then tighten its screw from underneath. Same on the next corner.

count-2.text: This step uses 2 clamp legs and 2 clamp screws.

step-3.text: Clamp the last two legs on the other corners. Snug every screw, but stop before it marks the wood.

count-3.text: This step uses 2 clamp legs and 2 clamp screws.

step-4.text: Turn it right side up. Lift it clear, do not lever it on two legs. If it rocks, loosen one clamp, push the leg square and tighten again.

count-4.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

done.text: Done. Your MODULAR TABLE modular table, small is built. Give it a proud little pat.
